content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Bhopal
Department of Computer Science and Engineering
SENSE-VIBE: Smart Environment Sensing through Vibration and Audio-Based Intelligence
Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Early Career Research Grant (File number: ANRF/ECRG/2025/001720/ENS)
Initially six (6) months, extendable up to a maximum of three (03) years
Google Form (CV in a single PDF file)
Open until the position is filled or the advertisement is withdrawn by the Institute

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative essential qualifications. In both, the candidate must be GATE/NET qualified. Option 1: B.Tech/B.E or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering and M.Tech/M.E in Computer Science and Engineering or equivalent, with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG for GEN/GEN-EWS/OBC-NCL, and a minimum of 55% aggregate marks or 6.0 CGPA at both UG and PG for SC/ST/PwD. OR Option 2: B.Tech/B.E or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering with at least 7.5/10 CGPA or 70% marks for GEN/GEN-EWS/OBC-NCL, and at least 7.0/10 CGPA or 65% for SC/ST/PwD. The CGPA or percentage must be awarded by a recognized University/Institute. Only the primary mode of evaluation (CGPA or percentage) shown on the qualifying degree certificate or mark sheet is considered when eligibility is verified. Good programming skills in Python and familiarity with scientific computing or machine learning libraries. Basic understanding of data visualization, exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical concepts. Familiarity with modern deep learning architectures, including CNNs and RNNs/LSTMs. Exposure to Transformer-based models for time series analysis is desirable but not mandatory. Age is counted as on the commencement date of this notification. The notice does not mention any experience requirement beyond the qualifications above, although an experience certificate is named among the documents to submit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month (consolidated) plus HRA. HRA will be provided if institute accommodation is not being provided. The appointment is initially for six (6) months and is extendable up to a maximum of three (03) years, based on satisfactory performance and subject to the availability of funds and project duration. The selected candidate will be encouraged to register for the PhD program at IIIT Bhopal as per institute norms.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says the duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work on developing and evaluating machine learning and deep learning models for time series data. Learn and implement advanced AI techniques, including Transformer-based models. Assist in data collection, preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis. Participate in experiments, result analysis, and documentation. Support other research activities related to the project under the guidance of the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Candidates submit a detailed softcopy of their CV, with all the documents below combined in a single PDF file, using the Google Form link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/8yBXJ1RJgFkfEakV7 . The notice names these documents: Detailed CV Degree Certificates and Marks Sheets GATE/UGC-NET qualifying certificates Date of Birth Proof Certificate Experience certificate For queries, the notice gives Dr. Priyankar Choudhary, Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, email [email protected] , contact 0755-2900140.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants must bring to the interview: One set of photocopies of all required documents, along with the original documents. Two passport-size photographs. Aadhaar card and one photocopy of the Aadhaar card for identification.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at IIIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Junior Research Fellow vacancy in the ANRF-ECRG project SENSE-VIBE.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: No fixed date is printed. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled or the advertisement is withdrawn by the Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E and M.Tech/M.E in Computer Science and Engineering with the stated minimum marks, or B.Tech/B.E in Computer Science and Engineering with higher minimum marks. In both cases the candidate must be GATE/NET qualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: The limit is 28 years for GEN/GEN-EWS, 31 years for OBC-NCL and 33 years for SC/ST/PwD/Female candidates, as on the commencement date of the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIIT Bhopal JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month (consolidated) plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: HRA is paid in addition to ₹37,000 only if institute accommodation is not being provided.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: Submit a detailed CV with the required certificates in a single PDF file through the Google Form named in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized periodically, and shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the interview. Interviews may be held periodically until the position is filled.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the IIIT Bhopal JRF appointment?
faq.answer: It is initially for six months and extendable up to a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance, availability of funds and project duration.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
